plan.schedule: Serial, alternating instrumented/plain order each repetition. No live coverage inference.
plan.selection: First connection, first bounded prefix for every configured pair; no substitution.

runs.limitation: Serial unpaced offline prefix; Kalshi-only journal, no other receivers, sampling or network waits. Historical clocks are NOT measured coverage. Commit wall time includes synchronization/checkpoint/scheduling, not isolated device latency.
